I don't force you to sell me products. I'll give you advice based on your skin type.
Proper skincare.
The acne extraction was very gentle and didn't hurt. After two weeks, my face was soft and the rash was gone. Now, my skin is smooth and my pores aren't sagging or enlarged.
Now, all that's left is to treat the acne scars. 🧒🧒
